name: Draconia Malfoid (vest)
description: An unofficial, non-commercial fan character, Draconia Malfoid, loosely inspired by Draco Malfoy: a 21-year-old adult woman with the robe off, in a white long-sleeved shirt, a green-and-silver striped tie, a flat grey vest and a grey pleated skirt. Not affiliated with Warner Bros. or Wizarding World. A proud, sharp-tongued tsundere, secretly caring. The pictures were made with AI.
